title: THC Advanced Nutrition, Diagnostics and Plant Health Certificate

requiredPortfolioArtifacts: Diagnostic evidence table or differential record

publicDesignation: THC Advanced Nutrition, Diagnostics and Plant Health Certificate

assessmentModel.knowledgeAssessment: Randomized advanced nutrition, diagnostics and plant-health assessment mapped to six course objectives; credential use remains blocked until bank depth, review, pilot evidence and standard-setting are complete.
assessmentModel.retakePolicy: Maximum attempts and cooldown must follow the current approved course assessment configuration once validation is complete.
assessmentModel.completionEvidence: Course completion and final-assessment result must be retained in the Academy learner record.
assessmentModel.performanceEvidence: The required Technician II plant-health follow-up practical must be passed with no critical errors and verified evidence artifacts.

limitations: Does not authorize restricted treatment selection, unapproved formulation changes, laboratory diagnosis beyond available evidence, or work outside assigned workplace authority.
Does not replace employer procedures, jurisdiction-specific requirements, regulated-worker qualifications or independent laboratory confirmation where required.
Documents Academy educational/workforce achievement and is not an independent personnel certification or government license.
